48.Name: TerritoryStone
48.Title: Territory Stone
48.value:
The stone is always at the center, independent of terrain chunks. Choose a radius of 4–32 blocks; the default 16 covers 33×33 blocks and the full world height. Territories cannot overlap. Each player may own one territory.

Default entry, exit, digging and placement permissions are independent; access can also be granted to individual players. Defaults block entry, allow exit, and block digging and placement. The owner and administrators are exempt. Teams do not affect permissions. Only the owner or an administrator may remove the stone; only the owner may edit settings.

Aim at the stone and press G or the edit button, then choose Apply. An overlapping resize is rejected by the server and the previous settings are restored. Boundary visibility is cosmetic: a faint grid appears on the full-height boundary near the viewer and fades with distance.

Protection only concerns player movement, digging and placement. Animals are not blocked. Privileged tp bypasses walking boundaries. PvP, projectiles, fire, explosions and piston damage are not covered by comprehensive territory protection.

When blocked, the owner and how to request access are shown. Use territory request <owner name or UUID>; no permissions are needed. Quote names containing spaces, or choose an owner from command suggestions. Both players must be online. One pending request per applicant, at least 30 seconds apart; requests expire after two minutes or disconnection. The owner independently selects entry, exit, digging and placement permissions or rejects the request. The applicant is notified and repeats the action. Grants add permission; they do not remove existing access or override allowed defaults, and never allow removing the stone. Grants persist with the world; edit or revoke them through Player access in the G panel.

Players with an existing grant cannot apply again; contact the owner to change permissions.
